providers.sourceAndCi: GitHub Free; container images built by GitHub Actions and stored in GHCR by digest
providers.pwaAndCdn: Azure Storage static websites (one account per shell) for the vendor, partner and admin static exports; the customer PWA and its same-origin BFF run as an Azure Container App
providers.compute: Azure Container Apps (consumption, Azure for Students) in Central India: api, shop and worker apps plus a Valkey app with internal TCP ingress
providers.queue: Valkey container app with internal TCP ingress in the same Container Apps environment
providers.ingress: Container Apps managed HTTPS ingress on the environment's azurecontainerapps.io domain; static shells on the storage accounts' HTTPS web endpoints
providers.routing: Mapbox Directions and Matrix (D-17) for road distance and travel time; the labelled estimate until MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN is injected

credentialPolicy: Provider credentials are stored only in provider secret stores, the company password manager and the VM's uncommitted release.env, and are never committed.

supersededTargets.objectStorage: Cloudflare R2, superseded by D-15 which approves Supabase Storage; the adapter is implemented, no bucket is provisioned
supersededTargets.pwaAndCdn: Cloudflare Pages for all four PWAs (D-12), Workers/OpenNext for the customer PWA (D-15) and Azure Static Web Apps (D-16 first draft: not creatable in the subscription's allowed regions), superseded by Azure Storage static websites for the shells and a container app for the customer PWA
supersededTargets.compute: OCI Always Free with a Cloudflare Tunnel (D-15 inventory) and an Azure VM (D-16 first draft: no B-series size is offered to the subscription, the smallest VM costs about $54/month), superseded by Azure Container Apps
supersededTargets.queue: Valkey on OCI, then on the Azure VM, superseded by a Valkey container app
supersededTargets.routing: Mappls (D-15 staging target), superseded by D-17 which selects Mapbox for the synthetic environments
